name: Christmas Roasted Beef Tenderloin (Chateaubriand) — Center-Cut Filet
whyItWorks: Beef tenderloin (filet mignon) is the leanest, most tender muscle on the cow, free of the heavy intramuscular fat seams and gristle found in standing rib roast (prime rib).
prepOrOrderInstructions: Roast with olive oil, kosher salt, and fresh rosemary/thyme sprigs (skip coarse cracked black peppercorn crusts and creamy horseradish sauce) and slice thin alongside whipped potatoes.
watchOuts: Avoid coarse peppercorn-crusted outer edges and pungent creamy horseradish sauce
